## Automation Audit Intake

Commercial intake for riera.co.uk.

Required env vars in the n8n container:
- `ESPOCRM_API_BASE_URL`
- `ESPOCRM_LEAD_CAPTURE_API_KEY`

This workflow uses EspoCRM Lead Capture instead of a general API user, so it can write leads without extra ACL setup. Qualification, payment, and scheduling happen after review.
